story.title: HILLWOOD EXPANDS ALLIANCETEXAS INDUSTRIAL PIPELINE WITH TWO NEW SPECULATIVE BUILDINGS
story.summary: Strong demand drives continued development as Hillwood advances an industrial pipeline totaling 8.9 million square feet FORT WORTH, Texas (November 19, 2026) — Responding to sustained demand for Class A industrial space in North Texas, Hillwood today announced plans to develop two speculative industrial buildings totaling 354,593 square feet at AllianceTexas.
